architecturePattern: Modular Monolith Core + Independently Deployed Applications (IDAs) + Micro-Frontends (MFEs)

advantages: CourseDiscovery IDA with Elasticsearch index absorbs high-read course search load
New content types can be introduced without modifying the core LearningManagementSystem (LMS)
disadvantages: Monolith is scaling bottleneck: LMS and ContentManagementSystem (CMS) share the same deployment unit
MySQL student data and MongoDB course data require separate consistency strategies
Celery/Redis introduces latency for grade processing

components.name: LearnerMFE
responsibilities: Student UI: course browsing, enrollment, video playback, progress tracking
Responsive design for desktop and mobile

components.name: AuthoringMFE
responsibilities: Content upload and course structure editing (OLP-S04)

components.name: APIGateway
responsibilities: Single entry point for all MFE and mobile client requests
Request routing to edx-platform LMS, CMS, and IDAs

components.name: LMS
responsibilities: Course content delivery to enrolled students

components.name: EcommerceService
responsibilities: Course enrollment order workflows: seat reservation, payment capture, enrollment confirmation)
Publishes successful and failed enrollment event)

components.name: CourseDiscoveryService
responsibilities: Consolidated course and program metadata aggregation
Updated via event bus on CoursePublished events

components.name: CredentialsService
responsibilities: Issue course completion certificates and program credentials
Retains credential issuance records for compliance audit

components.name: PaymentProviderAdapter
responsibilities: Circuit breaker and retry on provider failures

components.name: EventBus
responsibilities: Buffer enrollment and course update events during launch spikes

components.name: CacheLayer
responsibilities: Cache course listing and search API responses

components.name: AuditLogStore
responsibilities: Tamper-evident retention of all events: enrollment, payment, grade, credential issuance, and access events

components.name: StudentDB
responsibilities: Student enrollment records, grades, and progress

components.name: CredentialsDB
responsibilities: Certificate and program credential issuance records

components.name: ForumsDB
responsibilities: Discussion threads, comments, and subscription records

components.name: VideoStorage
responsibilities: Lecture video and course material hosting

components.name: CDN
responsibilities: Edge caching and delivery of video content

infrastructure.name: KubernetesCluster
infrastructure.details: LMS and CMS deployed as a shared Deployment (edx-platform); EcommerceService, CourseDiscoveryService, CredentialsService, and ForumsService deployed as independent deployments with separate HPA policies

infrastructure.name: ObservabilityStack
infrastructure.details: Celery task monitoring, Kafka consumer lag metrics via Prometheus; Grafana dashboards for enrollment throughput and LMS response times
